title: Digital Growth and AI Enablement | GOP
description: GOP finds practical uses of digital tools, automation and AI that improve growth, productivity and decisions, piloted on real data and measured.

nodes.name: Digital Growth and AI Enablement
nodes.description: In the decisions and hand-offs that cost the business money every week: quoting, lead follow-up, receivable chasing, planning, exception alerts and month-end reporting. GOP starts with the business objective, pilots a practical solution on real data and keeps it only if it measurably improves the work.

audience.audienceType: Promoter-led businesses, primarily INR 150-500 crore revenue, and their investors
